title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Wikimedia…
description: A Cross-site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in the Wikimedia Foundation MediaWiki CheckUser Extension, specifically in the StatusReasonFormatter.php file. This flaw affects versions from 1.46.0 up to but not including 1.46.3, and version 1.47. The vulnerability involves improper neutralization of input during web page generation, which could allow an attacker with high privileges and user interaction to execute script code in the context of the affected application. The issue has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 4.8. No public exploits or patches are currently documented.
